title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
lineage: AUD: reel master > CDR > EAC > CDR, 46:19
source: recorded by Marty Weinberg on a 5" Uher open-reel deck.

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience recording with mixed reception; standout Phil and Jerry moments but overall poor sound quality
ai_review.review: The tape captures the concert’s live feel better than the original soundboard, delivering a raw atmosphere that fans love, especially the strong playing from Phil Lesh and Jerry Garcia. However, reviewers criticize the technical flaws – wobble, muffled tones, and a cardboard‑tube like quality – making it one of the weaker sources for this show.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance gets some praise (Phil/Jerry tour de force) but the recording is widely regarded as poor; mixed reviewer scores lead to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Technical flaws and wobble, muffled/boxy sound described as hearing music through a cardboard tube with pillow stuffing; lacks the clarity of a proper soundboard.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as part of a "tour de force" with strong playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised alongside Jerry for an outstanding performance.
